result:
I searched the mempalace index for `PlanId` usage across billing, feature-flag, and plan-limit related code, then cross-checked with a full-repo grep to catch anything the semantic search missed (it turned up `src/components/domain/activity/activity-feed.tsx` and `tests/jobs/digest-email-job.test.ts`, which use `PlanId` in type annotations but weren't surfaced by the earlier searches).

Two files matched the grep for "PlanId" but only inside string-literal documentation payloads (component signature descriptions used to build `corpus-manifest.json`), not actual TypeScript type positions, so they're excluded: `scripts/manifest-parts/domain.ts` and `scripts/manifest-parts/server.ts`. Files like `command-groups.ts`, `tests/server/plan-limits.test.ts`, and the billing-service/usage-service call sites that only consume `getPlanLimits()`/`PlanLimits` numbers were also excluded, since they never name `PlanId` itself.

ANSWER: src/types/billing.ts, src/types/organization.ts, src/types/feature-flag.ts, src/types/event.ts, src/config/plan-limits.ts, src/schemas/billing.ts, src/lib/rate-limit.ts, src/server/db/seed.ts, src/server/services/billing-service.ts, src/server/repositories/subscription-repository.ts, src/components/domain/activity/activity-feed.tsx, src/components/domain/billing/billing-plan-card.tsx, src/components/domain/billing/plan-comparison-table.tsx, src/app/(dashboard)/[orgSlug]/settings/billing/page.tsx, src/app/(marketing)/_components/pricing-grid.tsx, tests/contract/plan-limits.test.ts, tests/config/nav.test.ts, tests/components/command-groups.test.ts, tests/jobs/digest-email-job.test.ts, tests/server/_support/fixtures.ts
